title: Tighten v16_to_v17_test.dart's FK-violation assertion beyond throwsA(anything)
why: The test's stated purpose is "C2: FK enforcement must reject completion with non-existent profileId", but `throwsA(anything)` is satisfied by ANY thrown object — a coincidental exception from unrelated test-setup breakage would make this pass without the FK constraint under test ever being exercised, silently losing the regression coverage it claims to provide. Every later migration-gate test in this same directory that checks a similar constraint (v25_to_v27_test.dart, v27_to_v28_test.dart) uses a typed matcher (`isA<SqliteException>()`/`isA<Exception>()`), so this is a real regression in assertion discipline, not a stylistic choice.
recommendation: Narrow to `throwsA(isA<SqliteException>())` (or the concrete exception type Drift/sqlite3 raises for an FK violation), matching the pattern used elsewhere in this same test directory.
acceptance_criteria: v16_to_v17_test.dart's FK test asserts a specific exception type, not `anything`
